name: Carnivore
blurb: Innate: Whenever  Cho'Gath kills an enemy, it  heals and restores  mana.

effects.description: Innate: Whenever Cho'Gath kills an enemy, it heals for 18 - 56 (based on level) and restores 4.72 - 10.04 (based on level) mana.

notes:
Carnivore will also trigger when Cho'Gath destroys a  turret, but not from other structures.
Carnivore does not trigger upon destroying  wards and possibly other similar units.
It does trigger upon killing one of  Illaoi's  Tentacles. [2]
